en.html:
While giving my respects, I fed heat into the Gattari.

About half the maximum output. Too much for indoors even so, but let that objection remain.

Sudden ignition. Exhaust. Every plate on my body shook at this thoroughly unreasonable production of thrust.

Forward.
Only forward.
No technique. Not even a sword held ready.

Haar maan li. Defeat accepted. Now, with that important matter out of the way, perhaps I could stop demonstrating how beautifully I lost and actually leave. The world's finest sword was welcome to remain the world's finest sword behind me.

I had already lost. Technique was no longer required!

　合当理に<ruby>熱<rt>ひ</rt></ruby>を入れる。

　出力は限界の半分程度。

en.html:
I launched forward with literally explosive thrust. Jouansai Yagyuu caught the very beginning of it perfectly, and his sword came at me.

An ordinary sword. But in this strange man's hands, ordinary was quite sufficient. A gap at any joint in a warrior's armor, and it could enter and deal a grave wound.

A killing blow in one stroke, though? Only the neck.
The heart was out of reach. Thick chest armor, carefully constructed to resist blades, could turn aside even a warrior's thrust.

So, the neck.
Protect that much.

ja.html:
文字通り爆発的な推力を得て進発する。
　その出端を見事に捉えて、柳生常闇斎の一剣は俺を
襲った。

　ただの刀に過ぎぬそれはしかし、この異相の男の手
にある限り、武者の全身にある関節部から潜り込んで
重傷を負わせ得る過不足ない凶器たる。
　が――

　一撃を以て致命傷を与えようと思うならそれはただ
一箇所、首を狙うほかにない。
　心臓は無理だ。分厚い甲鉄が計算し尽くされた耐刃
構造をとる劒冑の胸部は、武者の刺突でも跳ね除ける。

　だから、首。
　首さえ守ればいい。

en.html:
His blade found the gap at my shielding left elbow with exact precision and cut through skin, flesh and bone. Superhuman work. Fear froze my blood; admiration stopped my breath.

But even the head of the Yagyuu reached his limit there. After cutting through Muramasa's left arm, the blade had spent its force. It struck the helmet horn and bounced away lightly.

ja.html:
盾にした左腕、その肘関節の隙間を常闇斎の凶刃は
精確に<ruby>掴<rt>つか</rt></ruby>み、侵入し。皮から肉、肉から骨へと存分に
切り裂いた。――超人の手並み。
　恐怖に血は凍り、感嘆に息は止まる。

　だが柳生の長にしてそこまでが限度。
　村正の左腕を切り抜けた一刀は勢威を失い、兜角に
当たって軽く弾かれる。

en.html:
Details could look after themselves. I went forward.

The thrust seemed ready to leave the entire world behind. I let it carry me. Forward—my shoulder met Jouansai's chest and sent him back in an instant.

Even that collision had done this monster of a master no harm; I could tell. At contact he had leaned backward himself and let the shock pass. Fine. That was also acceptable.

Presumably he fell. I did not turn to check. Running, half flying, I went straight on.
Nothing remained in my way.

ja.html:
委細、構わず。
　俺はただ前へ進む。

　世界全てを置き去りにするが如き推力に身を任せ、
前方へ――――
　肩が常闇斎の胸元に接し。そして一瞬のうちに押し
飛ばした。

　この激突さえ、怪物じみた達人に何の痛痒も与えて
いないのがわかる――接触の瞬間自ら体を後方へ倒し、
衝撃を流している。
　しかし、構わない。

　倒れたであろう敵手に、俺は目も向けなかった。
　駆け抜ける。半ばは<ruby>騎航して<rt>とんで</rt></ruby>。ただ前へ。

　行く手を妨げるものは、最早何も無かった。
